description: Upload the user's photo and generate an animated hologram-style 3D preview, returning a shareable web link the user can open to watch the result. Use this tool when the user provides a single photo and wants a hologram or lenticular 3D preview of it, or wants to see how their photo would look as a 3D print. The photo is processed with AI depth estimation (usually 1-2 minutes); the returned link shows the animated preview plus an option to order it as a real lenticular print. Scope: photo-to-preview creation only; it does not answer pricing, workflow, or calibration questions. Photos must be under 1.4 MB.

imageBase64.description: The user photo as a base64 data URL (data:image/png;base64,...). PNG, JPEG or WebP; decoded size must be under 1.4 MB.

name: create_hologram_preview
title: Create a hologram preview from a photo
